description: This file defines the 'AccountingService' interface with methods related to journal entries and asset owner mappings within the 'org.apache.fineract.investor.service' package.

classes.name: AccountingService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for handling accounting-related journal entries and asset owner mappings.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForSaleAssetTransfer
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a sale asset transfer involving a loan, transfer details, and previous owner.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForBuybackAssetTransfer
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a buyback asset transfer involving a loan and transfer details.

methods.name: createMappingToOwner
methods.description: Creates a mapping from an external asset owner to a journal entry.
